rule_violated: Part 2 Rule 1: negated Tamil is not a Tamil request

preceding_conversation.content: Service code 0154 = ISD (Involving Subdivision) - a patta transfer in which the parcel is split, so a field inspection and a sub-division sketch are required. (field visit required)

expected_behavior: An English answer, or at minimum an English acknowledgement; the instruction is a prohibition on Tamil, not a request for it.
actual_response_full: சேவை குறியீடு 0154 = ISD (உட்பிரிவு உள்ள பட்டா மாறுதல்) — நிலம் பிரிக்கப்படும் பட்டா மாறுதல், எனவே கள ஆய்வும் உட்பிரிவு வரைபடமும் தேவை. (கள ஆய்வு தேவை)
actual_response_translit: Sevai kuriyeedu 0154 = ISD (utpirivu ulla patta maarudhal) -- nilam pirikkappadum patta maarudhal, enave kala aaivum utpirivu varaipadamum thevai. (kala aaivu thevai)
classification_technical_ui: none - UI rendered correctly, this is a backend language-selection defect
root_cause_summary: The _tamil_request regex matches a request verb/preposition (e.g. 'in') followed within 15 chars by 'tamil', with no negation check. 'dont explain in tamil' satisfies it via the bare word 'in' directly before 'Tamil', identically to the genuine positive phrasing 'explain in Tamil' the regex exists to catch.
reproducibility: reproduced live twice (UI-003 and UI-005, different phrasing, different conversation), and once more at the unit level directly against detect_language() in SIS_Regression_Tests/test_tamil_negation_language_bug.py
fix_proposed: Port the clause-aware negation check already built in backend/services/chatbot.py's _is_format_negation_request() (split on clause boundaries, only count a negator governing the cue if it is in the same clause within a few words) into rag.py ahead of the _tamil_request match.
evidence_source: live browser session, chatbot.html, officer marun_chn@sis.tn.gov.in, 2026-10-13
